description: Environment variable names read by the Go binary. Every key has a category (INV-ENV-04): secret, user_endpoint, host, or test. Platform configuration is never read from the environment: it is a typed default or an explicit flag.

categories.secret: API keys, tokens, client secrets, encryption keys
categories.user_endpoint: User-specific endpoint or identity with no correct universal default
categories.host: Host fact provided by the OS, read as a fact rather than as ztd configuration
categories.test: Test-harness selector read only by `ztd test` tooling and test code; never user configuration

OllamaEndpoint.description: Approved Ollama provider endpoint; default for --inference-ollama-endpoint on gw start, operator start, and operator model commands

E2EFleetSessions.description: Comma-separated owner Operator session identities selecting the live E2E fleet; unset selects the entire remote registry

Shell.description: Login shell reported by the host

Term.description: Terminal type reported by the host

TZ.description: Time zone reported by the host

Home.description: Home directory reported by the host

User.description: Login user name reported by the host

SSHAuthSock.description: SSH agent socket provided by the host session

XDGRuntimeDir.description: Per-user runtime directory provided by the host session; locates the systemd user ssh-agent sockets for the Linux master-key seal when SSH_AUTH_SOCK is unset

CloudflareAPIToken.description: Cloudflare API token for tunnel DNS routing
